mapper.select: select ba.id, ba.username, ba.avatar, ba.nickname, ba.tenant_id, ba.sex, ba.phone, ba.email, ba.status, ba.remark, bd.id as dept_id, bd.dept_name as dept_name, br.id as role_id, br.role_name as role_name, br.role_alias as role_alias from bedrock_admin ba left join bedrock_admin_dept bad on ba.id = bad.admin_id left join bedrock_dept bd on bad.dept_id = bd.id left join bedrock_admin_role bar on ba.id = bar.admin_id left join bedrock_role br on bar.role_id = br.id where ba.is_deleted = 0 and ba.id = #{id}
